TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place for the T-20 World Cup 2026 match between India and Namibia at Arun Jaitley Stadium on 12.02.2026. Traffic restrictions/diversions will apply in nearby areas for smooth conduct and public safety.

Time: 05:00 PM – 12:00 AM

📍 LIKELY AFFECTED ROADS
-JLN Marg (Rajghat to Delhi Gate up to R/A Kamla Market)
-Asaf Ali Road (Turkman Gate to Delhi Gate)
-Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg (Delhi Gate to Ramcharan Aggarwal Chowk)
-Ring Road (Rajghat to I.P. Flyover stretch)

📍 STADIUM ENTRY GATES
-Gates 1–8: Entry from Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg
-Gates 10–15: Entry from JLN Marg (Ambedkar Stadium side)
-Gates 16–18: Entry from BSZ Marg (Petrol Pump side)

📍 PARKING & PUBLIC ADVISORY
-General parking only at Mata Sundari Road, Rajghat Power House Road & Velodrome Road
-No roadside parking on notified roads, vehicles will be towed
-Near stadium parking only for labeled vehicles with valid passes

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

SEN. JV CALLS FOR RECALL OF CHINESE AMBASSADOR

WATCH: Senator JV Ejercito urged the recall of Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan, citing what he described as hostile public statements against PH officials defending the country’s position in the West Philippine Sea.

Ejercito said the ambassador’s actions have not helped improve already strained PH–China relations and instead 'added fuel to the fire,' stressing that the Philippines wants to exhaust diplomatic options and does not seek war. | via @hannaaahty, https://t.co/9R0Mcay5im
